mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to writing in journals, classifying means writing in ledgers and summarising relates to preparation of trading accounts, profit and loss account and balance sheet (Panda, 2011)."
Recording refers to writing in journals, classifying means writing in ledgers and summarising relates to preparation of trading accounts, profit and loss account and balance sheet (Panda, 2011).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an applied field of economics in which economic principles are applied in the use of scarce resources such as land, labour capital and management in farming and allied activities."

Agricultural economics is an applied field of economics in which economic principles are applied in the use of scarce resources such as land, labour capital and management in farming and allied activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the records of physical activities on the farm ii."
Farm records are the records of physical activities on the farm ii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the property that is pledged to serve as loans- e.g. bonds, shares, machinery, landed property etc."
Collateral Security is the property that is pledged to serve as loans- e.g. bonds, shares, machinery, landed property etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ultimate goal of cooperatives."
The satisfaction of members is the ultimate goal of cooperatives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a popular business concern in Nigeria and is mostly confined to agriculture and retailing business."
The sole proprietorship is a popular business concern in Nigeria and is mostly confined to agriculture and retailing business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount by which total value of assets exceed the total value of liabilities within a period of time."
Net worth or Net capital is the amount by which total value of assets exceed the total value of liabilities within a period of time.

Production planning in agriculture is a process or technique for making plans about optimum choice and combination of production enterprises.

Production is any activity that leads to the creation of goods and services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the production of crops, feeds, livestock, fish, forest product and wild life."
The major activities are the production of crops, feeds, livestock, fish, forest product and wild life.

True value of assets is known by allowing depreciation iv.
